This implies a cascade of interactions where Dihydropinosylvin may influence the activity of cis-Isopinocamphone, which then modulates the function of L-lactate dehydrogenase C chain. The presence of a final score of 0.5699 suggests a plausible but not definitive link, likely mediated through the transporter Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1A2, which serves as a bridge between Dihydropinosylvin and the downstream targets. The mechanism is supported by the observed targeting relationships, but further validation would be required to confirm the specific mode of action and the extent of the interaction.
